name: PHYS 3300
title: Statistical and Thermal Physics
description: The laws of thermodynamics and their microscopic statistical basis; entropy, temperature, Boltzmann factor, chemical potential, Gibbs factor, and the distribution functions.
requirement_description: PHYS 1230 or 1402Q or 1502Q or 1530 or 1602Q; PHYS 2300; MATH 2110Q and 2410Q, or MATH 2130Q and 2420Q. Recommended preparation: PHYS 3201 and 3401.
